name: sendGift
description: Sends a gift to the given user or channel chat. The gift can't be converted to Telegram Stars by the receiver. Returns _True_ on success.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Required if _chat\_id_ is not specified. Unique identifier of the target user who will receive the gift.

parameters.name: chat_id
parameters.description: Required if _user\_id_ is not specified. Unique identifier for the chat or username of the channel (in the format `@username`) that will receive the gift.

parameters.name: gift_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the gift; limited gifts can't be sent to channel chats

parameters.name: pay_for_upgrade
parameters.description: Pass _True_ to pay for the gift upgrade from the bot's balance, thereby making the upgrade free for the receiver

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text that will be shown along with the gift; 0-128 characters

parameters.name: text_parse_mode
parameters.description: Mode for parsing entities in the text. See [formatting options](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#formatting-options) for more details. Entities other than “bold”, “italic”, “underline”, “strikethrough”, “spoiler”, “custom\_emoji”, and “date\_time” are ignored.

parameters.name: text_entities
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized list of special entities that appear in the gift text. It can be specified instead of _text\_parse\_mode_. Entities other than “bold”, “italic”, “underline”, “strikethrough”, “spoiler”, “custom\_emoji”, and “date\_time” are ignored.
